decision: publish the hotfix and preserve the already-running root; do not cancel or duplicate it while it is still a valid running Kaggle kernel. If its old-code automatic continuation later fails, recover from the saved immutable checkpoint using the published hotfix commit rather than retrying the old child unchanged.
